name: set_mla_kv_buffer
description: Scatter selected rows into an MLA KV cache with signature set_mla_kv_buffer(kv_buffer, loc, cache_k_nope, cache_k_rope) -> torch.Tensor. kv_buffer has shape [num_slots, nope_dim + rope_dim]; loc is a 1-D integer tensor of n row indices; cache_k_nope has shape [n, nope_dim]; cache_k_rope has shape [n, rope_dim]. For each i, the concatenated row [cache_k_nope[i], cache_k_rope[i]] is written to kv_buffer[loc[i]], and all other rows are left unchanged. The buffer is mutated in place and the same tensor is returned; the Torch reference clones the buffer and returns a new tensor. An empty loc performs no writes and returns the buffer. When kv_buffer is 2-byte, row-contiguous, evenly aligned, and the noPE/rope dtypes and widths satisfy the packed conditions, aligned 2-element pairs are copied as uint32 words; otherwise a generic strided scatter stores values into the destination dtype. loc entries are expected to be valid row indices; duplicate indices and out-of-range indices are not exercised. The current tests exercise bfloat16 with num_slots=65536, nope_dim=512, rope_dim=64, and unique int64 loc values.
